args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action taken; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
